papers.title: Assessment of total hip arthroplasty as a predisposing factor for ischiofemoral impingement
papers.first_author_affiliation: Division of Musculoskeletal Imaging and Intervention, Massachusetts General Hospital and Harvard Medical School, Boston, MA, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Martin Torriani
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Division of Musculoskeletal Imaging and Intervention Department of Radiology, Massachusetts General Hospital, 55 Fruit Street-YAW 6048, Boston, MA, 02114, USA. mtorriani@mgh.harvard.edu

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注全髋关节置换术后坐骨股骨撞击，而非应力遮挡或微动分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it focuses on impingement geometry.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估全髋关节置换术是否为坐骨股骨撞击的易感因素。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析THA患者影像学参数与撞击的关系。
summary_zh.result: THA术后坐骨股骨间隙减小，可能增加撞击风险。
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床影像数据的回顾性分析。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether total hip arthroplasty predisposes patients to ischiofemoral impingement.
summary_en.method: Retrospective analysis of radiographic parameters in THA patients to assess impingement risk.
summary_en.result: THA leads to reduced ischiofemoral space, potentially increasing impingement risk.
